items.example: Let's touch base on Friday and see where we are.
items.exampleTr: Cuma günü kısaca görüşüp durumu değerlendirelim.
items.simple: You talk with someone for a short time to share news.

items.example: Let's get the ball rolling with a quick brainstorm.
items.exampleTr: Kısa bir beyin fırtınasıyla işi başlatalım.
items.simple: You start something so that other people can join in.

items.example: Finishing it by tomorrow is a tall order.
items.exampleTr: Bunu yarına bitirmek çok zor.
items.simple: Something you ask for that is very hard to do.

items.tr: (iş yükü için) boş kapasite, zaman ve enerji
items.example: I don't have the bandwidth to take on another project.
items.exampleTr: Bir proje daha alacak kapasitem yok.
items.simple: How much work you can do before you are too busy.
items.note: Teknik anlamı internet hızı; iş yerinde 'boş zaman/enerji'.

items.example: We need to keep all the stakeholders updated.
items.exampleTr: Tüm paydaşları bilgilendirmemiz gerek.
items.simple: A person who cares about the work because it touches them.

items.example: What are the main deliverables for this quarter?
items.exampleTr: Bu çeyrek için ana teslimatlar neler?
items.simple: The thing you must give to someone when the job is done.

items.example: Approval is the real bottleneck in our process.
items.exampleTr: Süreçteki asıl darboğaz onay aşaması.
items.simple: A small place where everything slows down, like a thin neck of a bottle.

items.example: We need buy-in from the whole team first.
items.exampleTr: Önce tüm ekibin desteğini almamız gerek.
items.simple: When people say yes and want to help with your idea.

items.example: We're trying to streamline the whole process.
items.exampleTr: Tüm süreci sadeleştirmeye çalışıyoruz.
items.simple: To make a job simpler and faster by taking away extra steps.

items.example: My old boss used to micromanage everything we did.
items.exampleTr: Eski patronum yaptığımız her şeye karışırdı.
items.simple: To watch every little thing people do and tell them how.

items.example: Can you loop Sarah in on this email?
items.exampleTr: Sarah'yı da bu e-postaya dahil edebilir misin?
items.simple: You tell a person what is going on so they can know too.

items.example: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the cost?
items.exampleTr: Maliyet için bana kabaca bir rakam verebilir misin?
items.simple: A number that is close, but not exact.

items.example: Let's take this offline and not waste everyone's time.
items.exampleTr: Bunu toplantı dışında konuşalım, herkesin zamanını almayalım.
items.simple: You talk about it later, just the two of you, not in front of everybody.

items.example: The client rejected it, so we're back to square one.
items.exampleTr: Müşteri reddetti, yani başa döndük.
items.simple: You must start again from the very beginning.

items.example: Sorry, I dropped the ball on that report.
items.exampleTr: Üzgünüm, o raporu aksattım.
items.simple: You forgot to do something that you had to do.

items.example: I'd push back on that deadline. It's not realistic.
items.exampleTr: O son tarihe itiraz ederdim. Gerçekçi değil.
items.simple: You say no, or not like that, to what someone wants.

items.tr: bir konunun peşini tutmak, takip etmek
items.example: I'll follow up on that with the supplier today.
items.exampleTr: Bunu bugün tedarikçiyle takip edeceğim.
items.simple: You do one more thing later to finish something you began.

items.example: It's important to set clear expectations from day one.
items.exampleTr: İlk günden net beklentiler belirlemek önemli.
items.simple: You tell people early what they will get and what you want.

items.example: A good manager knows how to delegate tasks.
items.exampleTr: İyi bir yönetici görev dağıtmayı bilir.
items.simple: You give some of your jobs to other people to do.

items.example: She called a meeting to discuss the budget.
items.exampleTr: Bütçeyi görüşmek için bir toplantı çağırdı.
items.simple: You ask people to come and sit and talk together.

items.example: We're working to a really tight deadline this month.
items.exampleTr: Bu ay gerçekten sıkışık bir takvimde çalışıyoruz.
items.simple: You have very little time to finish and must hurry.

items.en: Let's circle back to this. Let's circle back to this after lunch.
items.tr: Buna sonra dönelim. Öğle yemeğinden sonra buna dönelim.
items.example: Let's circle back to this once we have the numbers.
items.exampleTr: Rakamlar elimize geçince buna geri dönelim.
items.simple: You say you will talk about it again at a later time.

items.en: I'll keep you in the loop. I'll keep you in the loop on any changes.
items.example: Don't worry, I'll keep you in the loop.
items.exampleTr: Merak etme, seni haberdar ederim.
items.simple: You promise to tell the person what happens next.

items.en: Could you give me a heads-up? Could you give me a heads-up before you send it?
items.example: Could you give me a heads-up before you send it?
items.exampleTr: Göndermeden önce bana haber verir misin?
items.simple: You ask someone to tell you first, before the thing happens.
